channel.description: Recent content in Ideal Scenario on Senwa.space

item.title: Introduction
item.description: Ideal Scenario is a wholesome, easygoing smut book on the works. Enjoy!

item.title: Chapter 1: Your Way
item.description: My personal classic, rewritten. Girl with a crush really wants to get with this person but in their own way of doing things (no spoilers!)

item.title: Chapter 2: No One's Looking
item.description: In a park at night, watching stars, the whole shebang.

item.title: Chapter 3: House Party I
item.description: Strangers find love in a crowd and substances only kind of play a part.

item.title: Chapter 4: Painterly
item.description: Ella meets Markus in an art class, and they end up having to clean a mess together after it.

item.title: Chapter 5: Badlands
item.description: On a trip to Brazil, Maya, Elsa and Aubrey find a little piece of nowhere, and a taste of home.

item.title: Chapter 6: Community Involvement
item.description: Valerie gets a scholarship in Canada, and makes a friend.

item.title: Chapter 7: Expression
item.description: A friend sees another in a state of dysphoria, and wishes to turn that into feeling free.

item.title: Chapter 8: Flower Boy
item.description: An act of courage turns to a life changing moment. Picked the right flowers.

item.title: Chapter 9: The Sun on My Body
item.description: Samia finds an unlikely bit of love in a chaotic environment.

item.title: Chapter 10: Home-like
item.description: Leia goes on a trip and comes back with a soulmate, and quickly learns a friend had a secret.

item.title: Chapter 11: A Dove Dressed in Rain
item.description: A beautiful spark ignited in a poetry class.

item.title: Chapter 12: House Party II
item.description: A bunch of lipstick colours turns into a sitch.
